name: Asian Law Caucus
description: Free legal services in immigration, workers' rights, and housing for Asian and Pacific Islander communities
fullDescription: Asian Law Caucus provides free legal information, assistance, and referrals for low-income Asian American and Pacific Islander communities, with consultation and representation in some cases on immigration, housing, workers' rights, and civil rights.
whatTheyOffer:
- Help with immigration detention and deportation
- Workers' rights (unpaid wages, wrongful termination, discrimination, unemployment insurance, health and safety)
- Free, confidential tenant consultations, with a focus on Bay Area tenants
- Civil rights help (surveillance, profiling, police misconduct)
- Pardons and commutations
- Free interpretation in 200+ languages
howToGetIt:
1. Call 415-896-1701 (Monday–Friday, 10 AM–12 PM and 1–3 PM)
2. Or fill out the Get Help form on the Asian Law Caucus website
3. Complete eligibility screening (services are for low-income community members)
4. Receive legal information, a referral, or consultation and representation in some cases
keywords: Asian Law Caucus, Asian American, Pacific Islander, immigration, workers rights, housing, civil rights, language access, free legal, API community
